security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; font-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; frame-src 'none'

bundle.shortDescription: Server browser and launcher for Medal of Honor: Allied Assault
bundle.longDescription: Reveille finds an existing Medal of Honor: Allied Assault, Spearhead or Breakthrough installation, browses the servers answering now, checks what each one's rotation needs, installs exact missing-map matches, and launches the game.
